notes: The prompt names the genre itself - "a tycoon game", "the rest I want perfect replica of a tycoon" - so Simulation leads, and the powers-and-weapons PvP with a rising bounty per kill is a real second genre, so Action is named and supplies the pillars, anti-camp spawns and the bot emitters for the easy AI bots meant to give new players a little money. Ten franchise-themed bases, one per player slot and assigned by the wheel on pressing Play, is per-player buildable ground, so I kept the Tycoon preset and substituted plot-isolated for plot-shared, bent to the author's compact walking-distance map rather than the row's usual widely spaced plots. Decided without a user: the requested obby is treated as one reachable platforming section inside the tycoon map rather than a second genre, since the earning loop is the bases and not the course - naming Obby & Platformer here would import a genre-wide P6 this build never needed; the author's giant statue rides along as the landmark of the central social-hub plaza, and the franchise and home logos mark each base. The menu screen, spin wheel, titles, gamepasses and store UI are not layout and are left to the other systems; bases are exterior compounds with no enterable interiors, which keeps the route on P0.
